candidate.user_submission: Di pikin na 18 months old. E dey get ear pain. E no dey get ear discharge. E no get pus wey dey comot from ear. E no get tender swelling behind ear. Dem no see convulsion now. Dem no hear say e don get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic or unconscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E no get cough or dey find am hard to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E get ear wahala. E no get fever.
